reviews.text: Nicky is absolutely fantastic. He has minded our cat and parrot several times and they are so happy. Love getting the photos and texts every day. I recommend Nicky without hesitation!

Nicky walks our Dogue De Bordeaux Missy and our daughters rescue Pug Decko ( when he’s at ours) we’ve had many dogs over the years with many kennels, trainers, dog sitters etc and Nicky is by far the very best of the best . Our dogs love him as much as they do us they wait patiently at the door panting with wagging tails, they know when he’s coming !!!
We just cannot rate him highly enough the trust, reliability, great advice, and nothing is ever too much trouble - there simply aren’t enough stars 🌟 5 is not nearly enough 😇🐕🐕‍🦺

I cannot recommend Nicky enough. He is so incredible and patient. My dog, cloud she is so happy after every walk and they are so hardworking, I really appreciate Nicky and the lads. Brilliant service all around. Will continue to use this dog walking business.

I cannot recommend Nicky highly enough.
Nicky has been walking our dog Bear since he was a young pup and is extremely reliable and caring.
Very reliable - looks after my fur babies for me
A wonderful flexible and obliging company of dog walkers. Would recommend highly.
Nicky is fantastic. He's professional, reliable, and prompt to respond.

Nicky is just  a brilliant dog walker, but actually more than that! He truly cares about pets. We have two dogs and we ask him to walk one of them only, but he always makes sure the other doggy is fine in the house/lets her in the garden/ changes their water on hot days etc. He is also very reliable and flexible with dates. Would highly recommend him!
Fantastic business. Our dog loves seeing Paul and Nicky turning up for his walk!

Pet Angel Sitter is absolutely outstanding. When my dog Daisy developed an issue with her back leg and the vet ordered restricted movement, Nick went above and beyond to ensure she was safe and comfortable. He followed all the instructions carefully, kept her on the leash during walks, and was always calm, gentle, and attentive. Nick truly treated Daisy like one of his own — his care, reliability, and attention to detail gave me complete peace of mind during a stressful time. He is, without a doubt, one of the best pet sitters I’ve ever had. Thank you, Nick, for your kindness and professionalism!
Great service, extremely reliable and caring towards our 2 dogs and cat. Would highly recommend.
Nicky & team are the best! Super responsive & wonderful with our two fur babies. Highly recommend!

We have been delighted with Aleksandra from Pet Angel Sitters, led by Nicky. Since May 2024, Aleksandra has walked our dogs weekly, seamlessly becoming part of our routine. When our daughter was born, she went above and beyond, walking our pups every day for two weeks, providing invaluable support during that busy and emotional time. Our dogs adore her; they light up as soon as she arrives and return from their walks visibly content and cared for. Both Aleksandra and Nicky are reliable, caring, and deeply committed. Choosing Pet Angel Sitters has been one of the best decisions we’ve made for our pups!
Pet Angel Sitters are great. Nicky runs the business so well. A quick text the week before and your pet is booked in without any hassle. Big thanks to Nicky and Susan who's absolutely brilliant!
I have been using Nicky for a number of years now.  The absolute best service you could ever use.  Nicky is reliable and never lets us down. Great for advice and helpful information.
I've used Nicky for several years. Very reliable and he's a really good guy to deal with

I couldn’t recommend Nicky enough.
